note: Media Entity Link ships (config/install) a Link media type (media.type.link, id=link, source=link) backed by the 'link' MediaSource plugin (MediaEntityLink), with source field field_media_entity_link (core link field type, cardinality 1) on the link bundle. It needs no configuration and defines no permissions/Drush/settings form/configure route. Whether a Link media may use internal/external URLs is the core Link field setting link_type on field.field.media.link.field_media_entity_link (1=internal, 16=external, 17=both; shipped default 17). Medium/hard cases are grounded in real Link media entities and that real field_type setting. A Link media entity is a media of bundle 'link' with a name and a field_media_entity_link URI.

evals.prompt: What does enabling the Drupal media_entity_link module give you out of the box, and does it need any configuration?
evals.expected_output: It provides a 'link' media source plugin and a ready-made Link media type (media.type.link) installed automatically, so no configuration is needed. Link media represent internal or external URLs and appear in the Media Library.

evals.prompt: On the Link media type provided by media_entity_link, what is the machine name of the source field, and what core field type does it use?
evals.expected_output: The source field is field_media_entity_link, a core 'link' field type (cardinality 1) on the link media bundle; media.type.link references it as source_field.

evals.prompt: Using media_entity_link, how do I make the Link media type accept only external URLs (and where is internal-vs-external controlled)?
evals.expected_output: It is the standard core Link field 'Allowed link type' setting (link_type) on field.field.media.link.field_media_entity_link. Set link_type to 16 for external only (1=internal, 17=both). Change it under Manage fields or with drush cset.

evals.prompt: This site has a Link media entity (from the media_entity_link module) named 'Known MEL Resource'. Inspect the live site and state the URL it points to.
evals.expected_output: The Link media 'Known MEL Resource' points to https://example.com/known-mel-resource (its field_media_entity_link URI).

evals.prompt: On this site the Link media type (media_entity_link) has been configured to restrict what kind of URLs its link field accepts. Inspect the live field configuration and state whether it currently allows internal links, external links, or both.
evals.expected_output: It is restricted to external URLs only: field.field.media.link.field_media_entity_link has settings.link_type = 16 (LINK_EXTERNAL).

evals.prompt: Using the media_entity_link module's Link media type, create a Link media entity on this site that points to the external URL https://www.drupal.org/mel-task. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A media entity of bundle 'link' exists whose field_media_entity_link URI is https://www.drupal.org/mel-task (created via the media storage or the Media Library add form).

evals.prompt: Configure the Link media type provided by media_entity_link so that its link field accepts external URLs only (not internal paths). Apply the change to the live site.
